import Mathlib

/-!
# Shor's algorithm for a general period (reference proof)

Definitions mirror `Quantum_Basics.thy`; the three theorems `shor_factor`, `shor_peak` and
`shor_general_success` mirror `Shor_General.thy`.
-/

open Finset ComplexConjugate

noncomputable section

/-! ## Definitions -/

/-- A vector of dimension `n` is a function `ℕ → ℂ`; only its entries below `n` are read. -/
abbrev Vec := ℕ → ℂ

/-- `⟨u|v⟩ = ∑_{i<n} conj (u i) * v i` -/
def qinner (n : ℕ) (u v : Vec) : ℂ := ∑ i ∈ range n, conj (u i) * v i

/-- A state is a unit vector. -/
def is_state (n : ℕ) (v : Vec) : Prop := qinner n v v = 1

/-- Born rule: `|v j|²`. -/
def prob (v : Vec) (j : ℕ) : ℝ := ‖v j‖ ^ 2

/-- `cis θ = cos θ + i sin θ` -/
def cis (θ : ℝ) : ℂ := (Real.cos θ : ℂ) + (Real.sin θ : ℂ) * Complex.I

/-- Quantum Fourier transform on `ℤ_N`: `|k⟩ ↦ N^(-1/2) ∑_j e^(2πi jk/N) |j⟩`. -/
def qft (N : ℕ) (v : Vec) : Vec := fun j =>
  (∑ k ∈ range N, cis (2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) * v k) /
    ((Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)

/-- The uniform superposition over `{x0, x0 + r, x0 + 2r, …} ⊆ ℤ_N`, normalised by the number
of such indices. -/
def periodic_state (N r x0 : ℕ) : Vec := fun k =>
  if k < N ∧ k % r = x0 then
    (((1 / Real.sqrt (((range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)).card : ℝ) : ℝ)) : ℂ)
  else 0

/-- `r` is the multiplicative order of `a` modulo `n`. -/
def is_order (n a r : ℕ) : Prop :=
  0 < r ∧ a ^ r % n = 1 ∧ ∀ k, 0 < k → k < r → a ^ k % n ≠ 1

/-- Classical post-processing: the least denominator `b` of a fraction `a / b` within `1 / (2N)`
of the measured `j / N`. -/
def recover (N j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  sInf {b : ℕ | 0 < b ∧ ∃ a : ℤ, 2 * |(j : ℤ) * b - a * N| ≤ b}

/-- `recover N j` is the least `b` satisfying the defining predicate: this is the characterisation
of `LEAST` used below. -/
lemma recover_eq_of_least {N j r : ℕ} (hmem : 0 < r ∧ ∃ a : ℤ, 2 * |(j : ℤ) * r - a * N| ≤ r)
    (hmin : ∀ b : ℕ, (0 < b ∧ ∃ a : ℤ, 2 * |(j : ℤ) * b - a * N| ≤ b) → r ≤ b) :
    recover N j = r :=
  le_antisymm (Nat.sInf_le hmem) (le_csInf ⟨r, hmem⟩ fun b hb => hmin b hb)

/-! ## The classical step: an even period yields a factor -/

/-- With `b = a^(r/2)`: `n ∣ b² - 1 = (b - 1)(b + 1)`, but `n` divides neither factor, so
`gcd (b - 1) n` is a proper divisor of `n` other than `1`. -/
theorem shor_factor {n a r : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) (hord : is_order n a r) (heven : Even r)
    (hneg : a ^ (r / 2) % n ≠ n - 1) :
    1 < Nat.gcd (a ^ (r / 2) - 1) n ∧ Nat.gcd (a ^ (r / 2) - 1) n < n := by
  obtain ⟨hr, har, hmin⟩ := hord
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := heven
  have hs' : r / 2 = s := by omega
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by omega
  have hsr : s < r := by omega
  rw [hs'] at hneg ⊢
  have hn0 : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  have ha : 0 < a := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with rfl | h
    · simp [hr.ne'] at har
    · exact h
  have hpos : 1 ≤ a ^ s := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ ha
  -- work in the ring ZMod n with x = a^s
  set x : ZMod n := ((a ^ s : ℕ) : ZMod n) with hx
  have hx2 : x * x = 1 := by
    have : x * x = ((a ^ r : ℕ) : ZMod n) := by
      rw [hx, ← Nat.cast_mul, ← pow_add, ← hs]
    rw [this, ← ZMod.natCast_mod, har]; simp
  have hx1 : x ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have : ((a ^ s : ℕ) : ZMod n) = ((1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) := by rw [Nat.cast_one]; exact h
    rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff'] at this
    exact hmin s hs0 hsr (by rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hn] at this)
  have hxm1 : x ≠ -1 := by
    intro h
    apply hneg
    have : ((a ^ s : ℕ) : ZMod n) = ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hn.le, ZMod.natCast_self, Nat.cast_one, zero_sub]; exact h
    rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff'] at this
    rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : n - 1 < n)] at this
  -- x - 1 is nonzero and not a unit
  have hcast : ((a ^ s - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) = x - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hpos]; simp [hx]
  have hne : x - 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hx1
  have hnu : ¬ IsUnit (x - 1) := by
    intro hu
    have : (x - 1) * (x + 1) = 0 := by linear_combination hx2
    exact hxm1 (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left (hu.mul_right_eq_zero.mp this))
  have hncop : ¬ Nat.Coprime (a ^ s - 1) n := by
    rw [← ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime, hcast]; exact hnu
  -- translate back to gcd
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have h0 : Nat.gcd (a ^ s - 1) n ≠ 0 := (Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_right _ (by omega)).ne'
    have h1 : Nat.gcd (a ^ s - 1) n ≠ 1 := hncop
    omega
  · have hle : Nat.gcd (a ^ s - 1) n ≤ n := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _)
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne hle fun h => hne ?_
    rw [← hcast, ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]
    exact h ▸ Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _

/-! ## The periodic state for a general period -/

/-- For `x0 < r` and `x0 < N`, the indices below `N` congruent to `x0` are `x0 + m r` for
`m < L`, with `L = (N - 1 - x0) / r + 1`. -/
lemma residue_set {N r x0 : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hx0 : x0 < r) (hx0N : x0 < N) :
    (range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)
      = (range ((N - 1 - x0) / r + 1)).image (fun m => x0 + m * r) := by
  ext i
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_range, mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hi, hmod⟩
    have heq : x0 + i / r * r = i := by
      have := Nat.mod_add_div i r
      rw [hmod, Nat.mul_comm r] at this; exact this
    have h1 : i / r * r ≤ N - 1 - x0 := by omega
    have h2 : i / r ≤ (N - 1 - x0) / r := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hr).mpr h1
    exact ⟨i / r, by omega, heq⟩
  · rintro ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
    have h1 : m ≤ (N - 1 - x0) / r := by omega
    have h2 : m * r ≤ N - 1 - x0 := le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right r h1) (Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _)
    refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
    simp [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx0]

/-- Size of the residue class, and its enumeration as a sum. -/
lemma residue_count {N r x0 : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hx0 : x0 < r) (hx0N : x0 < N) (h : ℕ → ℂ) :
    0 < ((range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)).card ∧
    ((range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)).card * r ≤ N + r ∧
    N ≤ ((range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)).card * r + r ∧
    ∑ k ∈ range N, (if k < N ∧ k % r = x0 then h k else 0)
      = ∑ m ∈ range ((range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)).card, h (x0 + m * r) := by
  set q := (N - 1 - x0) / r with hq
  have hset := residue_set hr hx0 hx0N
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun m => x0 + m * r) (range (q + 1) : Set ℕ) := by
    intro a _ b _ hab
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hr (Nat.add_left_cancel hab)
  have hL : ((range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)).card = q + 1 := by
    rw [hset, card_image_of_injOn hinj, card_range]
  have h1 : q * r ≤ N - 1 - x0 := Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _
  have h2 : N - 1 - x0 < r * (q + 1) := Nat.lt_mul_div_succ _ hr
  have e : (q + 1) * r = q * r + r := by ring
  have e' : r * (q + 1) = q * r + r := by ring
  rw [hL]
  refine ⟨Nat.succ_pos _, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · omega
  · omega
  · calc ∑ k ∈ range N, (if k < N ∧ k % r = x0 then h k else 0)
        = ∑ k ∈ (range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0), h k := by
          rw [sum_filter]
          exact sum_congr rfl fun k hk => by simp [mem_range.mp hk]
      _ = ∑ m ∈ range (q + 1), h (x0 + m * r) := by rw [hset, sum_image hinj]

/-! ## Its Fourier amplitudes -/

lemma cis_eq_exp (θ : ℝ) : cis θ = Complex.exp (Complex.I * θ) := by
  rw [mul_comm, Complex.exp_mul_I, cis, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin]

lemma cis_add (a b : ℝ) : cis (a + b) = cis a * cis b := by
  simp only [cis_eq_exp, Complex.ofReal_add, mul_add, Complex.exp_add]

lemma norm_cis (θ : ℝ) : ‖cis θ‖ = 1 := by
  rw [cis_eq_exp, mul_comm]; exact Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I θ

/-- The amplitude of `qft N (periodic_state N r x0)` at `j` has the modulus of a sum of `L`
phases over `√L √N`, where `L` is the size of the residue class of `x0`. -/
lemma qft_periodic_norm {N r x0 : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hx0 : x0 < r) (hx0N : x0 < N) (j : ℕ) :
    ‖qft N (periodic_state N r x0) j‖
      = ‖∑ m ∈ range ((range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)).card,
          cis (2 * Real.pi * j * r * m / N)‖
        / (Real.sqrt (((range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)).card : ℝ) * Real.sqrt N) := by
  set L := ((range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)).card with hL
  set c : ℂ := ((1 / Real.sqrt (L : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) with hc
  set ph : ℂ := cis (2 * Real.pi * j * x0 / N) with hph
  -- each retained term factors as (constant) * (phase depending on m)
  have phase : ∀ m : ℕ, cis (2 * Real.pi * j * ((x0 + m * r : ℕ) : ℝ) / N) * c
      = c * ph * cis (2 * Real.pi * j * r * m / N) := by
    intro m
    have : 2 * Real.pi * j * ((x0 + m * r : ℕ) : ℝ) / N
        = 2 * Real.pi * j * x0 / N + 2 * Real.pi * j * r * m / N := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [this, cis_add]; ring
  have sum_eq : ∑ k ∈ range N, cis (2 * Real.pi * j * k / N) * periodic_state N r x0 k
      = c * ph * ∑ m ∈ range L, cis (2 * Real.pi * j * r * m / N) := by
    have h1 : ∑ k ∈ range N, cis (2 * Real.pi * j * k / N) * periodic_state N r x0 k
        = ∑ k ∈ range N, (if k < N ∧ k % r = x0 then cis (2 * Real.pi * j * k / N) * c else 0) := by
      refine sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      by_cases hk : k < N ∧ k % r = x0 <;> simp [periodic_state, hk, hc, hL]
    rw [h1, (residue_count hr hx0 hx0N (fun k => cis (2 * Real.pi * j * k / N) * c)).2.2.2,
      mul_sum]
    exact sum_congr rfl fun m _ => phase m
  have hnc : ‖c‖ = 1 / Real.sqrt L := by
    rw [hc, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  rw [qft, norm_div, sum_eq, norm_mul, norm_mul, hnc, hph, norm_cis, Complex.norm_real,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
  field_simp

/-- Only the distance `δ = j r - c N` to a multiple of `N` matters. -/
lemma phase_shift {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (j r m : ℕ) (c : ℤ) :
    cis (2 * Real.pi * j * r * m / N)
      = cis (m * (2 * Real.pi * (((j : ℤ) * r - c * N : ℤ) : ℝ) / N)) := by
  have hN' : (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hsplit : 2 * Real.pi * j * r * m / N
      = m * (2 * Real.pi * (((j : ℤ) * r - c * N : ℤ) : ℝ) / N) + 2 * Real.pi * ((c * m : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
    push_cast; field_simp; ring
  have hone : cis (2 * Real.pi * ((c * m : ℤ) : ℝ)) = 1 := by
    rw [cis_eq_exp]
    have : Complex.I * ((2 * Real.pi * ((c * m : ℤ) : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
        = ((c * m : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [this]; exact Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I _
  rw [hsplit, cis_add, hone, mul_one]

/-! ## Geometric sums of phases -/

lemma norm_cis_sub_one (b : ℝ) : ‖cis b - 1‖ = 2 * |Real.sin (b / 2)| := by
  rw [cis_eq_exp, Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal_sub_one, norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  simp

lemma cis_sum_norm (L : ℕ) {t : ℝ} (hs : Real.sin (t / 2) ≠ 0) :
    ‖∑ m ∈ range L, cis (m * t)‖ = |Real.sin (L * t / 2)| / |Real.sin (t / 2)| := by
  have hpow : ∀ m : ℕ, cis (m * t) = cis t ^ m := by
    intro m
    rw [cis_eq_exp, cis_eq_exp, ← Complex.exp_nat_mul]
    congr 1; push_cast; ring
  have hgeom : (∑ m ∈ range L, cis t ^ m) * (cis t - 1) = cis (L * t) - 1 := by
    rw [geom_sum_mul, hpow]
  simp_rw [hpow]
  have h1 : ‖cis (L * t) - 1‖ = ‖∑ m ∈ range L, cis t ^ m‖ * ‖cis t - 1‖ := by
    rw [← hgeom, norm_mul]
  rw [norm_cis_sub_one, norm_cis_sub_one] at h1
  have hpos : 0 < |Real.sin (t / 2)| := abs_pos.mpr hs
  rw [eq_div_iff hpos.ne']
  nlinarith [h1]

/-! ## Jordan's inequality on both sides of `π / 2` -/

lemma jordan_both_sides {t : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (hpi : t ≤ Real.pi) :
    2 / Real.pi * min t (Real.pi - t) ≤ Real.sin t := by
  rcases le_total t (Real.pi / 2) with h | h
  · calc 2 / Real.pi * min t (Real.pi - t) ≤ 2 / Real.pi * t := by
          gcongr; exact min_le_left _ _
      _ ≤ Real.sin t := Real.mul_le_sin h0 h
  · have h' := Real.mul_le_sin (x := Real.pi - t) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    rw [Real.sin_pi_sub] at h'
    calc 2 / Real.pi * min t (Real.pi - t) ≤ 2 / Real.pi * (Real.pi - t) := by
          gcongr; exact min_le_right _ _
      _ ≤ Real.sin t := h'

/-! ## The peak bound -/

/-- Pure real arithmetic behind the peak bound. -/
lemma peak_arith {n s l g : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hsn : s < n) (hl : 0 < l) (hls : l * s ≤ n + s)
    (hg : 2 / Real.pi * ((n - s) / s) ≤ g) :
    4 / (Real.pi ^ 2 * s) * (1 - s / n) ^ 3 ≤ g ^ 2 / (l * n) := by
  have hn : 0 < n := hs.trans hsn
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  set g0 := 2 / Real.pi * ((n - s) / s) with hg0
  have hg0nn : 0 ≤ g0 := by
    have : 0 ≤ n - s := by linarith
    positivity
  -- step 1: replace g0 by g
  have step1 : g0 ^ 2 / (l * n) ≤ g ^ 2 / (l * n) := by
    gcongr
  -- step 2: l ≤ (n + s) / s
  have step2 : g0 ^ 2 * s / ((n + s) * n) ≤ g0 ^ 2 / (l * n) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hls (by positivity : 0 ≤ g0 ^ 2 * n)
    nlinarith [this]
  -- step 3: the explicit constant
  have step3 : 4 / (Real.pi ^ 2 * s) * (1 - s / n) ^ 3 ≤ g0 ^ 2 * s / ((n + s) * n) := by
    have key : 4 / (Real.pi ^ 2 * s) * (1 - s / n) ^ 3
        = g0 ^ 2 * s / ((n + s) * n) * ((n - s) * (n + s) / n ^ 2) := by
      rw [hg0]; field_simp; ring
    have r2 : (n - s) * (n + s) / n ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]; nlinarith
    rw [key]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity) r2
  linarith

/-- For any period `0 < r < N`, an outcome `j` within `r / 2` of a multiple `c N / r` has
probability at least `4 / (π² r) (1 - r/N)³`. Write `δ = j r - c N` and `φ = π δ / N`; the
amplitude is `|sin (L φ)| / |sin φ|` over `√(L N)`, and Jordan's inequality bounds it below. -/
theorem shor_peak {N r x0 j : ℕ} {c : ℤ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrN : r < N) (hx0 : x0 < r) (hj : j < N)
    (near : 2 * |(j : ℤ) * r - c * N| ≤ r) :
    is_state N (periodic_state N r x0) ∧
      4 / (Real.pi ^ 2 * r) * (1 - (r : ℝ) / N) ^ 3 ≤ prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j := by
  have hx0N : x0 < N := hx0.trans hrN
  have hN : 0 < N := hr.trans hrN
  set L := ((range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)).card with hL
  obtain ⟨hL0, hL1, hL2, -⟩ := residue_count hr hx0 hx0N (fun _ => 0)
  have hLpos : (0 : ℝ) < L := by exact_mod_cast hL0
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  have hrR : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hrNR : (r : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hrN
  have hNR : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hLr : (L : ℝ) * r ≤ N + r := by exact_mod_cast hL1
  have hNLr : (N : ℝ) - r ≤ L * r := by
    have : (N : ℝ) ≤ L * r + r := by exact_mod_cast hL2
    linarith
  constructor
  · -- the state is normalised
    set c0 : ℂ := ((1 / Real.sqrt (L : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) with hc0
    have hcc : conj c0 * c0 = ((1 / (L : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      have : 1 / Real.sqrt (L : ℝ) * (1 / Real.sqrt (L : ℝ)) = 1 / (L : ℝ) := by
        rw [div_mul_div_comm, one_mul, Real.mul_self_sqrt hLpos.le]
      rw [hc0, Complex.conj_ofReal, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, this]
    have h1 : qinner N (periodic_state N r x0) (periodic_state N r x0)
        = ∑ k ∈ range N, (if k < N ∧ k % r = x0 then conj c0 * c0 else 0) := by
      refine sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      by_cases hk : k < N ∧ k % r = x0 <;> simp [periodic_state, hk, hc0, hL]
    rw [is_state, h1, (residue_count hr hx0 hx0N (fun _ => conj c0 * c0)).2.2.2, ← hL]
    simp only [hcc, sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_natCast, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, mul_one_div_cancel hLpos.ne']
    simp
  · -- the peak probability
    set d : ℤ := (j : ℤ) * r - c * N with hd
    set φ : ℝ := Real.pi * (d : ℝ) / N with hφ
    set G : ℂ := ∑ m ∈ range L, cis (m * (2 * φ)) with hG
    have hnormG : ‖qft N (periodic_state N r x0) j‖ = ‖G‖ / (Real.sqrt L * Real.sqrt N) := by
      rw [qft_periodic_norm hr hx0 hx0N j, ← hL]
      congr 2
      refine sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
      rw [phase_shift hN j r m c, ← hd]
      congr 2
      rw [hφ]; ring
    have hprob : prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j = ‖G‖ ^ 2 / (L * N) := by
      rw [prob, hnormG, div_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hLpos.le, Real.sq_sqrt hNR.le]
    -- lower bound on the modulus of the geometric sum of phases
    have lower : 2 / Real.pi * (((N : ℝ) - r) / r) ≤ ‖G‖ := by
      by_cases hd0 : d = 0
      · have hφ0 : φ = 0 := by simp [hφ, hd0]
        have hG' : G = (L : ℂ) := by simp [hG, hφ0, cis]
        rw [hG', Complex.norm_natCast]
        have h1 : ((N : ℝ) - r) / r ≤ L := by rw [div_le_iff₀ hrR]; exact hNLr
        have h2 : 2 / Real.pi ≤ 1 := by
          rw [div_le_one hpi]; linarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
        have h3 : 0 ≤ ((N : ℝ) - r) / r := by
          apply div_nonneg <;> linarith
        calc 2 / Real.pi * (((N : ℝ) - r) / r) ≤ 1 * (((N : ℝ) - r) / r) := by gcongr
          _ ≤ L := by linarith
      · have hdr : 2 * |(d : ℝ)| ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast near
        have hφle : |φ| ≤ Real.pi * r / (2 * N) := by
          rw [hφ, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hpi, abs_of_pos hNR, div_le_div_iff₀ hNR (by positivity)]
          nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdr hpi.le) hNR.le]
        have hφpos : 0 < |φ| := by
          rw [hφ]; positivity
        have hsmall : |φ| < Real.pi / 2 := by
          refine lt_of_le_of_lt hφle ?_
          rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
          nlinarith
        -- `sin |φ|` is positive and `|sin φ| = sin |φ| ≤ |φ|`
        have hsinpos : 0 < Real.sin |φ| :=
          Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hφpos (by linarith)
        have hbd : -Real.pi < φ ∧ φ < Real.pi := abs_lt.mp (lt_trans hsmall (by linarith))
        have habs_sin : |Real.sin φ| = Real.sin |φ| := by
          rcases le_total 0 φ with h | h
          · rw [abs_of_nonneg h, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi h hbd.2.le)]
          · have hs := Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (x := -φ) (by linarith) (by linarith)
            rw [Real.sin_neg] at hs
            rw [abs_of_nonpos h, Real.sin_neg, abs_of_nonpos (by linarith : Real.sin φ ≤ 0)]
        have hsin1 : 0 < |Real.sin φ| := habs_sin ▸ hsinpos
        have hsin2 : |Real.sin φ| ≤ |φ| := habs_sin ▸ Real.sin_le hφpos.le
        set t : ℝ := L * |φ| with ht
        have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := by positivity
        have htpi : t ≤ Real.pi := by
          calc t ≤ L * (Real.pi * r / (2 * N)) := by rw [ht]; gcongr
            _ = Real.pi / 2 * (L * r / N) := by field_simp
            _ ≤ Real.pi / 2 * 2 := by
              gcongr
              rw [div_le_iff₀ hNR]; linarith
            _ = Real.pi := by ring
        have hsinL : |Real.sin (L * φ)| = Real.sin t := by
          rcases le_total 0 φ with h | h
          · have e : t = L * φ := by rw [ht, abs_of_nonneg h]
            rw [← e]; exact abs_of_nonneg (Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi ht0 htpi)
          · have e : t = -(L * φ) := by rw [ht, abs_of_nonpos h]; ring
            have hst := Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi ht0 htpi
            rw [e, Real.sin_neg] at hst ⊢
            exact abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)
        have hnorm : ‖G‖ = Real.sin t / |Real.sin φ| := by
          have hs : Real.sin (2 * φ / 2) ≠ 0 := by
            rw [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ two_ne_zero]; exact (abs_pos.mp hsin1)
          have := cis_sum_norm L hs
          rw [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (two_ne_zero' ℝ)] at this
          rw [hG, this, ← hsinL]; congr 2; ring_nf
        -- Jordan's inequality, applied on whichever side of `π / 2` the angle `L φ` lies
        have hmin : 2 / Real.pi * (((N : ℝ) - r) / r) * |φ| ≤ 2 / Real.pi * min t (Real.pi - t) := by
          have hA : ((N : ℝ) - r) / r * |φ| ≤ t := by
            rw [ht]; gcongr
            rw [div_le_iff₀ hrR]; exact hNLr
          have hB : ((N : ℝ) - r) / r * |φ| ≤ Real.pi - t := by
            have hsum : (L : ℝ) + ((N : ℝ) - r) / r ≤ 2 * N / r := by
              have : (L : ℝ) + ((N : ℝ) - r) / r = (L * r + (N - r)) / r := by field_simp
              rw [this]; gcongr; linarith
            have : ((L : ℝ) + ((N : ℝ) - r) / r) * |φ| ≤ (2 * N / r) * (Real.pi * r / (2 * N)) := by
              gcongr
            have h2 : (2 * (N : ℝ) / r) * (Real.pi * r / (2 * N)) = Real.pi := by field_simp
            rw [ht]; nlinarith
          have := le_min hA hB
          rw [mul_assoc]; gcongr
        have hsin_t := jordan_both_sides ht0 htpi
        have h5 : 2 / Real.pi * (((N : ℝ) - r) / r) ≤ Real.sin t / |φ| := by
          rw [le_div_iff₀ hφpos]; exact hmin.trans hsin_t
        rw [hnorm]
        exact h5.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi ht0 htpi) hsin1 hsin2)
    rw [hprob]
    exact peak_arith hrR hrNR hLpos hLr lower

/-! ## Recovering the period -/

/-- If `j/N` is within `1/(2N)` of `c/r` with `c` coprime to `r` and `r² < N`, no fraction with a
smaller denominator is that close: two such fractions `c/r ≠ a/b` would differ by at least
`1/(r b) > 1/N`. -/
lemma recover_period {N r j : ℕ} {c : ℤ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrr : r * r < N) (hcop : IsCoprime c (r : ℤ))
    (near : 2 * |(j : ℤ) * r - c * N| ≤ r) : recover N j = r := by
  refine recover_eq_of_least ⟨hr, c, near⟩ ?_
  rintro b ⟨hb, a, hab⟩
  by_contra hrb
  have hbr : b < r := not_le.mp hrb
  -- N |b c - a r| = |r (j b - a N) - b (j r - c N)| ≤ r b
  have hid : (N : ℤ) * |(b : ℤ) * c - a * r|
      = |(r : ℤ) * ((j : ℤ) * b - a * N) - b * ((j : ℤ) * r - c * N)| := by
    have : (r : ℤ) * ((j : ℤ) * b - a * N) - b * ((j : ℤ) * r - c * N)
        = N * ((b : ℤ) * c - a * r) := by ring
    rw [this, abs_mul, Nat.abs_cast]
  have hle : (N : ℤ) * |(b : ℤ) * c - a * r| ≤ r * b := by
    have htri : |(r : ℤ) * ((j : ℤ) * b - a * N) - b * ((j : ℤ) * r - c * N)|
        ≤ r * |(j : ℤ) * b - a * N| + b * |(j : ℤ) * r - c * N| := by
      refine (abs_sub _ _).trans ?_
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, Nat.abs_cast, Nat.abs_cast]
    have h1 : (r : ℤ) * (2 * |(j : ℤ) * b - a * N|) ≤ r * b :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hab (by positivity)
    have h2 : (b : ℤ) * (2 * |(j : ℤ) * r - c * N|) ≤ b * r :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left near (by positivity)
    rw [hid]; nlinarith
  have hlt : (r : ℤ) * b < N := by
    have : r * b < N := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.mul_le_mul_left r hbr.le) (by nlinarith)
    exact_mod_cast this
  -- hence b c = a r
  have hzero : |(b : ℤ) * c - a * r| < 1 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    nlinarith
  have heq : (b : ℤ) * c = a * r := by
    have := abs_lt.mp hzero
    omega
  -- so r divides b, contradicting 0 < b < r
  have hdvd : (r : ℤ) ∣ (b : ℤ) * c := ⟨a, by rw [heq]; ring⟩
  have hdvd' : (r : ℤ) ∣ b := hcop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hdvd
  have : r ∣ b := Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mp hdvd'
  exact absurd (Nat.le_of_dvd hb this) (not_le.mpr hbr)

/-- One run of Shor's algorithm (QFT, measure `j`, output `recover N j`) returns the period with
probability at least `4/π² · φ(r)/r · (1 - r/N)³`: each `c < r` coprime to `r` has its own nearest
outcome `j_c = round (c N / r)`, these are distinct, and each is recovered and has the peak
probability. -/
theorem shor_general_success {N r x0 : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrr : r * r < N) (hx0 : x0 < r) :
    4 / Real.pi ^ 2 * ((((range r).filter (fun c => Nat.Coprime c r)).card : ℝ) / r)
        * (1 - (r : ℝ) / N) ^ 3
      ≤ ∑ j ∈ (range N).filter (fun j => recover N j = r),
          prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j := by
  have hrN : r < N := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_mul_self r) hrr
  set C := (range r).filter (fun c => Nat.Coprime c r) with hC
  set jc : ℕ → ℕ := fun c => (2 * c * N + r) / (2 * r) with hjc
  set bound : ℝ := 4 / (Real.pi ^ 2 * r) * (1 - (r : ℝ) / N) ^ 3 with hbound
  -- `jc c` is the integer nearest to `c N / r`
  have near : ∀ c : ℕ, 2 * |((jc c : ℕ) : ℤ) * r - (c : ℤ) * N| ≤ r := by
    intro c
    have lo : jc c * (2 * r) ≤ 2 * c * N + r := Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _
    have hi : 2 * c * N + r < r * (jc c + 1) * 2 := by
      have := Nat.lt_mul_div_succ (2 * c * N + r) (by omega : 0 < 2 * r)
      show _ < r * ((2 * c * N + r) / (2 * r) + 1) * 2
      linarith
    have lo' : (2 * ((jc c : ℤ) * r)) ≤ 2 * ((c : ℤ) * N) + r := by
      have : ((jc c * (2 * r) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ ((2 * c * N + r : ℕ) : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast lo
      push_cast at this; linarith
    have hi' : 2 * ((c : ℤ) * N) + r < 2 * ((jc c : ℤ) * r) + 2 * r := by
      have : ((2 * c * N + r : ℕ) : ℤ) < ((r * (jc c + 1) * 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hi
      push_cast at this; linarith
    rcases abs_cases ((jc c : ℤ) * r - (c : ℤ) * N) with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩ <;> rw [h] <;> linarith
  have jc_lt : ∀ c : ℕ, c < r → jc c < N := by
    intro c hc
    have h1 : (c + 1) * N ≤ r * N := Nat.mul_le_mul_right N hc
    show (2 * c * N + r) / (2 * r) < N
    rw [Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (by omega)]
    nlinarith
  -- every `jc c` is an outcome from which the period is recovered
  have hit : C.image jc ⊆ (range N).filter (fun j => recover N j = r) := by
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨c, hcC, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hj
    obtain ⟨hcr, hcop⟩ := mem_filter.mp hcC
    have hcop' : IsCoprime (c : ℤ) (r : ℤ) := Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.mpr hcop
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_range.mpr (jc_lt c (mem_range.mp hcr)),
      recover_period hr hrr hcop' (near c)⟩
  -- distinct `c` give distinct outcomes
  have hinj : Set.InjOn jc (C : Set ℕ) := by
    intro c _ c' _ heq
    have h1 := near c
    have h2 := near c'
    rw [heq] at h1
    have h3 : |((c : ℤ) - c') * N| ≤ r := by
      have : (c - c') * (N : ℤ) = (((jc c' : ℕ) : ℤ) * r - c' * N) - (((jc c' : ℕ) : ℤ) * r - c * N) := by
        ring
      rw [this]
      refine (abs_sub _ _).trans ?_
      rw [abs_sub_comm (((jc c' : ℕ) : ℤ) * r) (c * N)] at h1 ⊢
      linarith [abs_nonneg (((jc c' : ℕ) : ℤ) * r - c' * N)]
    have h4 : |(c : ℤ) - c'| < 1 := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      rw [abs_mul, Nat.abs_cast] at h3
      nlinarith
    have := abs_lt.mp h4
    omega
  have peak : ∀ c ∈ C, bound ≤ prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) (jc c) := by
    intro c hc
    have hcr := mem_range.mp (mem_filter.mp hc).1
    exact (shor_peak hr hrN hx0 (jc_lt c hcr) (near c)).2
  calc 4 / Real.pi ^ 2 * (((C.card : ℝ)) / r) * (1 - (r : ℝ) / N) ^ 3
      = ∑ _c ∈ C, bound := by
        rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hbound]; field_simp
    _ ≤ ∑ c ∈ C, prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) (jc c) := sum_le_sum peak
    _ = ∑ j ∈ C.image jc, prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j := (sum_image hinj).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ (range N).filter (fun j => recover N j = r),
          prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j :=
        sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hit fun _ _ _ => by unfold prob; positivity

import Mathlib

/-!
# Shor's algorithm for a general period (reference proof)

Definitions mirror `Quantum_Basics.thy`; the three theorems `shor_factor`, `shor_peak` and
`shor_general_success` mirror `Shor_General.thy`.
-/

open Finset ComplexConjugate

noncomputable section

/-! ## Definitions -/

/-- A vector of dimension `n` is a function `ℕ → ℂ`; only its entries below `n` are read. -/
abbrev Vec := ℕ → ℂ

/-- `⟨u|v⟩ = ∑_{i<n} conj (u i) * v i` -/
def qinner (n : ℕ) (u v : Vec) : ℂ := ∑ i ∈ range n, conj (u i) * v i

/-- A state is a unit vector. -/
def is_state (n : ℕ) (v : Vec) : Prop := qinner n v v = 1

/-- Born rule: `|v j|²`. -/
def prob (v : Vec) (j : ℕ) : ℝ := ‖v j‖ ^ 2

/-- `cis θ = cos θ + i sin θ` -/
def cis (θ : ℝ) : ℂ := (Real.cos θ : ℂ) + (Real.sin θ : ℂ) * Complex.I

/-- Quantum Fourier transform on `ℤ_N`: `|k⟩ ↦ N^(-1/2) ∑_j e^(2πi jk/N) |j⟩`. -/
def qft (N : ℕ) (v : Vec) : Vec := fun j =>
  (∑ k ∈ range N, cis (2 * Real.pi * (j : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) * v k) /
    ((Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)

/-- The uniform superposition over `{x0, x0 + r, x0 + 2r, …} ⊆ ℤ_N`, normalised by the number
of such indices. -/
def periodic_state (N r x0 : ℕ) : Vec := fun k =>
  if k < N ∧ k % r = x0 then
    (((1 / Real.sqrt (((range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)).card : ℝ) : ℝ)) : ℂ)
  else 0

/-- `r` is the multiplicative order of `a` modulo `n`. -/
def is_order (n a r : ℕ) : Prop :=
  0 < r ∧ a ^ r % n = 1 ∧ ∀ k, 0 < k → k < r → a ^ k % n ≠ 1

/-- Classical post-processing: the least denominator `b` of a fraction `a / b` within `1 / (2N)`
of the measured `j / N`. -/
def recover (N j : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  sInf {b : ℕ | 0 < b ∧ ∃ a : ℤ, 2 * |(j : ℤ) * b - a * N| ≤ b}

/-- `recover N j` is the least `b` satisfying the defining predicate: this is the characterisation
of `LEAST` used below. -/
lemma recover_eq_of_least {N j r : ℕ} (hmem : 0 < r ∧ ∃ a : ℤ, 2 * |(j : ℤ) * r - a * N| ≤ r)
    (hmin : ∀ b : ℕ, (0 < b ∧ ∃ a : ℤ, 2 * |(j : ℤ) * b - a * N| ≤ b) → r ≤ b) :
    recover N j = r :=
  le_antisymm (Nat.sInf_le hmem) (le_csInf ⟨r, hmem⟩ fun b hb => hmin b hb)

/-! ## The classical step: an even period yields a factor -/

/-- With `b = a^(r/2)`: `n ∣ b² - 1 = (b - 1)(b + 1)`, but `n` divides neither factor, so
`gcd (b - 1) n` is a proper divisor of `n` other than `1`. -/
theorem shor_factor {n a r : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) (hord : is_order n a r) (heven : Even r)
    (hneg : a ^ (r / 2) % n ≠ n - 1) :
    1 < Nat.gcd (a ^ (r / 2) - 1) n ∧ Nat.gcd (a ^ (r / 2) - 1) n < n := by
  obtain ⟨hr, har, hmin⟩ := hord
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := heven
  have hs' : r / 2 = s := by omega
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by omega
  have hsr : s < r := by omega
  rw [hs'] at hneg ⊢
  have hn0 : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  have ha : 0 < a := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with rfl | h
    · simp [hr.ne'] at har
    · exact h
  have hpos : 1 ≤ a ^ s := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ ha
  -- work in the ring ZMod n with x = a^s
  set x : ZMod n := ((a ^ s : ℕ) : ZMod n) with hx
  have hx2 : x * x = 1 := by
    have : x * x = ((a ^ r : ℕ) : ZMod n) := by
      rw [hx, ← Nat.cast_mul, ← pow_add, ← hs]
    rw [this, ← ZMod.natCast_mod, har]; simp
  have hx1 : x ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have : ((a ^ s : ℕ) : ZMod n) = ((1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) := by rw [Nat.cast_one]; exact h
    rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff'] at this
    exact hmin s hs0 hsr (by rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hn] at this)
  have hxm1 : x ≠ -1 := by
    intro h
    apply hneg
    have : ((a ^ s : ℕ) : ZMod n) = ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hn.le, ZMod.natCast_self, Nat.cast_one, zero_sub]; exact h
    rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff'] at this
    rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : n - 1 < n)] at this
  -- x - 1 is nonzero and not a unit
  have hcast : ((a ^ s - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod n) = x - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hpos]; simp [hx]
  have hne : x - 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hx1
  have hnu : ¬ IsUnit (x - 1) := by
    intro hu
    have : (x - 1) * (x + 1) = 0 := by linear_combination hx2
    exact hxm1 (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left (hu.mul_right_eq_zero.mp this))
  have hncop : ¬ Nat.Coprime (a ^ s - 1) n := by
    rw [← ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime, hcast]; exact hnu
  -- translate back to gcd
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have h0 : Nat.gcd (a ^ s - 1) n ≠ 0 := (Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_right _ (by omega)).ne'
    have h1 : Nat.gcd (a ^ s - 1) n ≠ 1 := hncop
    omega
  · have hle : Nat.gcd (a ^ s - 1) n ≤ n := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _)
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne hle fun h => hne ?_
    rw [← hcast, ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]
    exact h ▸ Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _

/-! ## The periodic state for a general period -/

/-- For `x0 < r` and `x0 < N`, the indices below `N` congruent to `x0` are `x0 + m r` for
`m < L`, with `L = (N - 1 - x0) / r + 1`. -/
lemma residue_set {N r x0 : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hx0 : x0 < r) (hx0N : x0 < N) :
    (range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)
      = (range ((N - 1 - x0) / r + 1)).image (fun m => x0 + m * r) := by
  ext i
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_range, mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hi, hmod⟩
    have heq : x0 + i / r * r = i := by
      have := Nat.mod_add_div i r
      rw [hmod, Nat.mul_comm r] at this; exact this
    have h1 : i / r * r ≤ N - 1 - x0 := by omega
    have h2 : i / r ≤ (N - 1 - x0) / r := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hr).mpr h1
    exact ⟨i / r, by omega, heq⟩
  · rintro ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
    have h1 : m ≤ (N - 1 - x0) / r := by omega
    have h2 : m * r ≤ N - 1 - x0 := le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right r h1) (Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _)
    refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
    simp [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx0]

/-- Size of the residue class, and its enumeration as a sum. -/
lemma residue_count {N r x0 : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hx0 : x0 < r) (hx0N : x0 < N) (h : ℕ → ℂ) :
    0 < ((range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)).card ∧
    ((range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)).card * r ≤ N + r ∧
    N ≤ ((range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)).card * r + r ∧
    ∑ k ∈ range N, (if k < N ∧ k % r = x0 then h k else 0)
      = ∑ m ∈ range ((range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)).card, h (x0 + m * r) := by
  set q := (N - 1 - x0) / r with hq
  have hset := residue_set hr hx0 hx0N
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun m => x0 + m * r) (range (q + 1) : Set ℕ) := by
    intro a _ b _ hab
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hr (Nat.add_left_cancel hab)
  have hL : ((range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)).card = q + 1 := by
    rw [hset, card_image_of_injOn hinj, card_range]
  have h1 : q * r ≤ N - 1 - x0 := Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _
  have h2 : N - 1 - x0 < r * (q + 1) := Nat.lt_mul_div_succ _ hr
  have e : (q + 1) * r = q * r + r := by ring
  have e' : r * (q + 1) = q * r + r := by ring
  rw [hL]
  refine ⟨Nat.succ_pos _, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · omega
  · omega
  · calc ∑ k ∈ range N, (if k < N ∧ k % r = x0 then h k else 0)
        = ∑ k ∈ (range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0), h k := by
          rw [sum_filter]
          exact sum_congr rfl fun k hk => by simp [mem_range.mp hk]
      _ = ∑ m ∈ range (q + 1), h (x0 + m * r) := by rw [hset, sum_image hinj]

/-! ## Its Fourier amplitudes -/

lemma cis_eq_exp (θ : ℝ) : cis θ = Complex.exp (Complex.I * θ) := by
  rw [mul_comm, Complex.exp_mul_I, cis, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin]

lemma cis_add (a b : ℝ) : cis (a + b) = cis a * cis b := by
  simp only [cis_eq_exp, Complex.ofReal_add, mul_add, Complex.exp_add]

lemma norm_cis (θ : ℝ) : ‖cis θ‖ = 1 := by
  rw [cis_eq_exp, mul_comm]; exact Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I θ

/-- The amplitude of `qft N (periodic_state N r x0)` at `j` has the modulus of a sum of `L`
phases over `√L √N`, where `L` is the size of the residue class of `x0`. -/
lemma qft_periodic_norm {N r x0 : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hx0 : x0 < r) (hx0N : x0 < N) (j : ℕ) :
    ‖qft N (periodic_state N r x0) j‖
      = ‖∑ m ∈ range ((range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)).card,
          cis (2 * Real.pi * j * r * m / N)‖
        / (Real.sqrt (((range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)).card : ℝ) * Real.sqrt N) := by
  set L := ((range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)).card with hL
  set c : ℂ := ((1 / Real.sqrt (L : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) with hc
  set ph : ℂ := cis (2 * Real.pi * j * x0 / N) with hph
  -- each retained term factors as (constant) * (phase depending on m)
  have phase : ∀ m : ℕ, cis (2 * Real.pi * j * ((x0 + m * r : ℕ) : ℝ) / N) * c
      = c * ph * cis (2 * Real.pi * j * r * m / N) := by
    intro m
    have : 2 * Real.pi * j * ((x0 + m * r : ℕ) : ℝ) / N
        = 2 * Real.pi * j * x0 / N + 2 * Real.pi * j * r * m / N := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [this, cis_add]; ring
  have sum_eq : ∑ k ∈ range N, cis (2 * Real.pi * j * k / N) * periodic_state N r x0 k
      = c * ph * ∑ m ∈ range L, cis (2 * Real.pi * j * r * m / N) := by
    have h1 : ∑ k ∈ range N, cis (2 * Real.pi * j * k / N) * periodic_state N r x0 k
        = ∑ k ∈ range N, (if k < N ∧ k % r = x0 then cis (2 * Real.pi * j * k / N) * c else 0) := by
      refine sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      by_cases hk : k < N ∧ k % r = x0 <;> simp [periodic_state, hk, hc, hL]
    rw [h1, (residue_count hr hx0 hx0N (fun k => cis (2 * Real.pi * j * k / N) * c)).2.2.2,
      mul_sum]
    exact sum_congr rfl fun m _ => phase m
  have hnc : ‖c‖ = 1 / Real.sqrt L := by
    rw [hc, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  rw [qft, norm_div, sum_eq, norm_mul, norm_mul, hnc, hph, norm_cis, Complex.norm_real,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
  field_simp

/-- Only the distance `δ = j r - c N` to a multiple of `N` matters. -/
lemma phase_shift {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (j r m : ℕ) (c : ℤ) :
    cis (2 * Real.pi * j * r * m / N)
      = cis (m * (2 * Real.pi * (((j : ℤ) * r - c * N : ℤ) : ℝ) / N)) := by
  have hN' : (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hsplit : 2 * Real.pi * j * r * m / N
      = m * (2 * Real.pi * (((j : ℤ) * r - c * N : ℤ) : ℝ) / N) + 2 * Real.pi * ((c * m : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
    push_cast; field_simp; ring
  have hone : cis (2 * Real.pi * ((c * m : ℤ) : ℝ)) = 1 := by
    rw [cis_eq_exp]
    have : Complex.I * ((2 * Real.pi * ((c * m : ℤ) : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
        = ((c * m : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [this]; exact Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I _
  rw [hsplit, cis_add, hone, mul_one]

/-! ## Geometric sums of phases -/

lemma norm_cis_sub_one (b : ℝ) : ‖cis b - 1‖ = 2 * |Real.sin (b / 2)| := by
  rw [cis_eq_exp, Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal_sub_one, norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  simp

lemma cis_sum_norm (L : ℕ) {t : ℝ} (hs : Real.sin (t / 2) ≠ 0) :
    ‖∑ m ∈ range L, cis (m * t)‖ = |Real.sin (L * t / 2)| / |Real.sin (t / 2)| := by
  have hpow : ∀ m : ℕ, cis (m * t) = cis t ^ m := by
    intro m
    rw [cis_eq_exp, cis_eq_exp, ← Complex.exp_nat_mul]
    congr 1; push_cast; ring
  have hgeom : (∑ m ∈ range L, cis t ^ m) * (cis t - 1) = cis (L * t) - 1 := by
    rw [geom_sum_mul, hpow]
  simp_rw [hpow]
  have h1 : ‖cis (L * t) - 1‖ = ‖∑ m ∈ range L, cis t ^ m‖ * ‖cis t - 1‖ := by
    rw [← hgeom, norm_mul]
  rw [norm_cis_sub_one, norm_cis_sub_one] at h1
  have hpos : 0 < |Real.sin (t / 2)| := abs_pos.mpr hs
  rw [eq_div_iff hpos.ne']
  nlinarith [h1]

/-! ## Jordan's inequality on both sides of `π / 2` -/

lemma jordan_both_sides {t : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ t) (hpi : t ≤ Real.pi) :
    2 / Real.pi * min t (Real.pi - t) ≤ Real.sin t := by
  rcases le_total t (Real.pi / 2) with h | h
  · calc 2 / Real.pi * min t (Real.pi - t) ≤ 2 / Real.pi * t := by
          gcongr; exact min_le_left _ _
      _ ≤ Real.sin t := Real.mul_le_sin h0 h
  · have h' := Real.mul_le_sin (x := Real.pi - t) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    rw [Real.sin_pi_sub] at h'
    calc 2 / Real.pi * min t (Real.pi - t) ≤ 2 / Real.pi * (Real.pi - t) := by
          gcongr; exact min_le_right _ _
      _ ≤ Real.sin t := h'

/-! ## The peak bound -/

/-- Pure real arithmetic behind the peak bound. -/
lemma peak_arith {n s l g : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hsn : s < n) (hl : 0 < l) (hls : l * s ≤ n + s)
    (hg : 2 / Real.pi * ((n - s) / s) ≤ g) :
    4 / (Real.pi ^ 2 * s) * (1 - s / n) ^ 3 ≤ g ^ 2 / (l * n) := by
  have hn : 0 < n := hs.trans hsn
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  set g0 := 2 / Real.pi * ((n - s) / s) with hg0
  have hg0nn : 0 ≤ g0 := by
    have : 0 ≤ n - s := by linarith
    positivity
  -- step 1: replace g0 by g
  have step1 : g0 ^ 2 / (l * n) ≤ g ^ 2 / (l * n) := by
    gcongr
  -- step 2: l ≤ (n + s) / s
  have step2 : g0 ^ 2 * s / ((n + s) * n) ≤ g0 ^ 2 / (l * n) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hls (by positivity : 0 ≤ g0 ^ 2 * n)
    nlinarith [this]
  -- step 3: the explicit constant
  have step3 : 4 / (Real.pi ^ 2 * s) * (1 - s / n) ^ 3 ≤ g0 ^ 2 * s / ((n + s) * n) := by
    have key : 4 / (Real.pi ^ 2 * s) * (1 - s / n) ^ 3
        = g0 ^ 2 * s / ((n + s) * n) * ((n - s) * (n + s) / n ^ 2) := by
      rw [hg0]; field_simp; ring
    have r2 : (n - s) * (n + s) / n ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]; nlinarith
    rw [key]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity) r2
  linarith

/-- For any period `0 < r < N`, an outcome `j` within `r / 2` of a multiple `c N / r` has
probability at least `4 / (π² r) (1 - r/N)³`. Write `δ = j r - c N` and `φ = π δ / N`; the
amplitude is `|sin (L φ)| / |sin φ|` over `√(L N)`, and Jordan's inequality bounds it below. -/
theorem shor_peak {N r x0 j : ℕ} {c : ℤ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrN : r < N) (hx0 : x0 < r) (hj : j < N)
    (near : 2 * |(j : ℤ) * r - c * N| ≤ r) :
    is_state N (periodic_state N r x0) ∧
      4 / (Real.pi ^ 2 * r) * (1 - (r : ℝ) / N) ^ 3 ≤ prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j := by
  have hx0N : x0 < N := hx0.trans hrN
  have hN : 0 < N := hr.trans hrN
  set L := ((range N).filter (fun i => i % r = x0)).card with hL
  obtain ⟨hL0, hL1, hL2, -⟩ := residue_count hr hx0 hx0N (fun _ => 0)
  have hLpos : (0 : ℝ) < L := by exact_mod_cast hL0
  have hpi := Real.pi_pos
  have hrR : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hrNR : (r : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hrN
  have hNR : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hLr : (L : ℝ) * r ≤ N + r := by exact_mod_cast hL1
  have hNLr : (N : ℝ) - r ≤ L * r := by
    have : (N : ℝ) ≤ L * r + r := by exact_mod_cast hL2
    linarith
  constructor
  · -- the state is normalised
    set c0 : ℂ := ((1 / Real.sqrt (L : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) with hc0
    have hcc : conj c0 * c0 = ((1 / (L : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      have : 1 / Real.sqrt (L : ℝ) * (1 / Real.sqrt (L : ℝ)) = 1 / (L : ℝ) := by
        rw [div_mul_div_comm, one_mul, Real.mul_self_sqrt hLpos.le]
      rw [hc0, Complex.conj_ofReal, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, this]
    have h1 : qinner N (periodic_state N r x0) (periodic_state N r x0)
        = ∑ k ∈ range N, (if k < N ∧ k % r = x0 then conj c0 * c0 else 0) := by
      refine sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      by_cases hk : k < N ∧ k % r = x0 <;> simp [periodic_state, hk, hc0, hL]
    rw [is_state, h1, (residue_count hr hx0 hx0N (fun _ => conj c0 * c0)).2.2.2, ← hL]
    simp only [hcc, sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_natCast, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, mul_one_div_cancel hLpos.ne']
    simp
  · -- the peak probability
    set d : ℤ := (j : ℤ) * r - c * N with hd
    set φ : ℝ := Real.pi * (d : ℝ) / N with hφ
    set G : ℂ := ∑ m ∈ range L, cis (m * (2 * φ)) with hG
    have hnormG : ‖qft N (periodic_state N r x0) j‖ = ‖G‖ / (Real.sqrt L * Real.sqrt N) := by
      rw [qft_periodic_norm hr hx0 hx0N j, ← hL]
      congr 2
      refine sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
      rw [phase_shift hN j r m c, ← hd]
      congr 2
      rw [hφ]; ring
    have hprob : prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j = ‖G‖ ^ 2 / (L * N) := by
      rw [prob, hnormG, div_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hLpos.le, Real.sq_sqrt hNR.le]
    -- lower bound on the modulus of the geometric sum of phases
    have lower : 2 / Real.pi * (((N : ℝ) - r) / r) ≤ ‖G‖ := by
      by_cases hd0 : d = 0
      · have hφ0 : φ = 0 := by simp [hφ, hd0]
        have hG' : G = (L : ℂ) := by simp [hG, hφ0, cis]
        rw [hG', Complex.norm_natCast]
        have h1 : ((N : ℝ) - r) / r ≤ L := by rw [div_le_iff₀ hrR]; exact hNLr
        have h2 : 2 / Real.pi ≤ 1 := by
          rw [div_le_one hpi]; linarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
        have h3 : 0 ≤ ((N : ℝ) - r) / r := by
          apply div_nonneg <;> linarith
        calc 2 / Real.pi * (((N : ℝ) - r) / r) ≤ 1 * (((N : ℝ) - r) / r) := by gcongr
          _ ≤ L := by linarith
      · have hdr : 2 * |(d : ℝ)| ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast near
        have hφle : |φ| ≤ Real.pi * r / (2 * N) := by
          rw [hφ, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hpi, abs_of_pos hNR, div_le_div_iff₀ hNR (by positivity)]
          nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdr hpi.le) hNR.le]
        have hφpos : 0 < |φ| := by
          rw [hφ]; positivity
        have hsmall : |φ| < Real.pi / 2 := by
          refine lt_of_le_of_lt hφle ?_
          rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
          nlinarith
        -- `sin |φ|` is positive and `|sin φ| = sin |φ| ≤ |φ|`
        have hsinpos : 0 < Real.sin |φ| :=
          Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi hφpos (by linarith)
        have hbd : -Real.pi < φ ∧ φ < Real.pi := abs_lt.mp (lt_trans hsmall (by linarith))
        have habs_sin : |Real.sin φ| = Real.sin |φ| := by
          rcases le_total 0 φ with h | h
          · rw [abs_of_nonneg h, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi h hbd.2.le)]
          · have hs := Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi (x := -φ) (by linarith) (by linarith)
            rw [Real.sin_neg] at hs
            rw [abs_of_nonpos h, Real.sin_neg, abs_of_nonpos (by linarith : Real.sin φ ≤ 0)]
        have hsin1 : 0 < |Real.sin φ| := habs_sin ▸ hsinpos
        have hsin2 : |Real.sin φ| ≤ |φ| := habs_sin ▸ Real.sin_le hφpos.le
        set t : ℝ := L * |φ| with ht
        have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := by positivity
        have htpi : t ≤ Real.pi := by
          calc t ≤ L * (Real.pi * r / (2 * N)) := by rw [ht]; gcongr
            _ = Real.pi / 2 * (L * r / N) := by field_simp
            _ ≤ Real.pi / 2 * 2 := by
              gcongr
              rw [div_le_iff₀ hNR]; linarith
            _ = Real.pi := by ring
        have hsinL : |Real.sin (L * φ)| = Real.sin t := by
          rcases le_total 0 φ with h | h
          · have e : t = L * φ := by rw [ht, abs_of_nonneg h]
            rw [← e]; exact abs_of_nonneg (Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi ht0 htpi)
          · have e : t = -(L * φ) := by rw [ht, abs_of_nonpos h]; ring
            have hst := Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi ht0 htpi
            rw [e, Real.sin_neg] at hst ⊢
            exact abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)
        have hnorm : ‖G‖ = Real.sin t / |Real.sin φ| := by
          have hs : Real.sin (2 * φ / 2) ≠ 0 := by
            rw [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ two_ne_zero]; exact (abs_pos.mp hsin1)
          have := cis_sum_norm L hs
          rw [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (two_ne_zero' ℝ)] at this
          rw [hG, this, ← hsinL]; congr 2; ring_nf
        -- Jordan's inequality, applied on whichever side of `π / 2` the angle `L φ` lies
        have hmin : 2 / Real.pi * (((N : ℝ) - r) / r) * |φ| ≤ 2 / Real.pi * min t (Real.pi - t) := by
          have hA : ((N : ℝ) - r) / r * |φ| ≤ t := by
            rw [ht]; gcongr
            rw [div_le_iff₀ hrR]; exact hNLr
          have hB : ((N : ℝ) - r) / r * |φ| ≤ Real.pi - t := by
            have hsum : (L : ℝ) + ((N : ℝ) - r) / r ≤ 2 * N / r := by
              have : (L : ℝ) + ((N : ℝ) - r) / r = (L * r + (N - r)) / r := by field_simp
              rw [this]; gcongr; linarith
            have : ((L : ℝ) + ((N : ℝ) - r) / r) * |φ| ≤ (2 * N / r) * (Real.pi * r / (2 * N)) := by
              gcongr
            have h2 : (2 * (N : ℝ) / r) * (Real.pi * r / (2 * N)) = Real.pi := by field_simp
            rw [ht]; nlinarith
          have := le_min hA hB
          rw [mul_assoc]; gcongr
        have hsin_t := jordan_both_sides ht0 htpi
        have h5 : 2 / Real.pi * (((N : ℝ) - r) / r) ≤ Real.sin t / |φ| := by
          rw [le_div_iff₀ hφpos]; exact hmin.trans hsin_t
        rw [hnorm]
        exact h5.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi ht0 htpi) hsin1 hsin2)
    rw [hprob]
    exact peak_arith hrR hrNR hLpos hLr lower

/-! ## Recovering the period -/

/-- If `j/N` is within `1/(2N)` of `c/r` with `c` coprime to `r` and `r² < N`, no fraction with a
smaller denominator is that close: two such fractions `c/r ≠ a/b` would differ by at least
`1/(r b) > 1/N`. -/
lemma recover_period {N r j : ℕ} {c : ℤ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrr : r * r < N) (hcop : IsCoprime c (r : ℤ))
    (near : 2 * |(j : ℤ) * r - c * N| ≤ r) : recover N j = r := by
  refine recover_eq_of_least ⟨hr, c, near⟩ ?_
  rintro b ⟨hb, a, hab⟩
  by_contra hrb
  have hbr : b < r := not_le.mp hrb
  -- N |b c - a r| = |r (j b - a N) - b (j r - c N)| ≤ r b
  have hid : (N : ℤ) * |(b : ℤ) * c - a * r|
      = |(r : ℤ) * ((j : ℤ) * b - a * N) - b * ((j : ℤ) * r - c * N)| := by
    have : (r : ℤ) * ((j : ℤ) * b - a * N) - b * ((j : ℤ) * r - c * N)
        = N * ((b : ℤ) * c - a * r) := by ring
    rw [this, abs_mul, Nat.abs_cast]
  have hle : (N : ℤ) * |(b : ℤ) * c - a * r| ≤ r * b := by
    have htri : |(r : ℤ) * ((j : ℤ) * b - a * N) - b * ((j : ℤ) * r - c * N)|
        ≤ r * |(j : ℤ) * b - a * N| + b * |(j : ℤ) * r - c * N| := by
      refine (abs_sub _ _).trans ?_
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, Nat.abs_cast, Nat.abs_cast]
    have h1 : (r : ℤ) * (2 * |(j : ℤ) * b - a * N|) ≤ r * b :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hab (by positivity)
    have h2 : (b : ℤ) * (2 * |(j : ℤ) * r - c * N|) ≤ b * r :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left near (by positivity)
    rw [hid]; nlinarith
  have hlt : (r : ℤ) * b < N := by
    have : r * b < N := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.mul_le_mul_left r hbr.le) (by nlinarith)
    exact_mod_cast this
  -- hence b c = a r
  have hzero : |(b : ℤ) * c - a * r| < 1 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    nlinarith
  have heq : (b : ℤ) * c = a * r := by
    have := abs_lt.mp hzero
    omega
  -- so r divides b, contradicting 0 < b < r
  have hdvd : (r : ℤ) ∣ (b : ℤ) * c := ⟨a, by rw [heq]; ring⟩
  have hdvd' : (r : ℤ) ∣ b := hcop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hdvd
  have : r ∣ b := Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mp hdvd'
  exact absurd (Nat.le_of_dvd hb this) (not_le.mpr hbr)

/-- One run of Shor's algorithm (QFT, measure `j`, output `recover N j`) returns the period with
probability at least `4/π² · φ(r)/r · (1 - r/N)³`: each `c < r` coprime to `r` has its own nearest
outcome `j_c = round (c N / r)`, these are distinct, and each is recovered and has the peak
probability. -/
theorem shor_general_success {N r x0 : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrr : r * r < N) (hx0 : x0 < r) :
    4 / Real.pi ^ 2 * ((((range r).filter (fun c => Nat.Coprime c r)).card : ℝ) / r)
        * (1 - (r : ℝ) / N) ^ 3
      ≤ ∑ j ∈ (range N).filter (fun j => recover N j = r),
          prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j := by
  have hrN : r < N := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_mul_self r) hrr
  set C := (range r).filter (fun c => Nat.Coprime c r) with hC
  set jc : ℕ → ℕ := fun c => (2 * c * N + r) / (2 * r) with hjc
  set bound : ℝ := 4 / (Real.pi ^ 2 * r) * (1 - (r : ℝ) / N) ^ 3 with hbound
  -- `jc c` is the integer nearest to `c N / r`
  have near : ∀ c : ℕ, 2 * |((jc c : ℕ) : ℤ) * r - (c : ℤ) * N| ≤ r := by
    intro c
    have lo : jc c * (2 * r) ≤ 2 * c * N + r := Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _
    have hi : 2 * c * N + r < r * (jc c + 1) * 2 := by
      have := Nat.lt_mul_div_succ (2 * c * N + r) (by omega : 0 < 2 * r)
      show _ < r * ((2 * c * N + r) / (2 * r) + 1) * 2
      linarith
    have lo' : (2 * ((jc c : ℤ) * r)) ≤ 2 * ((c : ℤ) * N) + r := by
      have : ((jc c * (2 * r) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ ((2 * c * N + r : ℕ) : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast lo
      push_cast at this; linarith
    have hi' : 2 * ((c : ℤ) * N) + r < 2 * ((jc c : ℤ) * r) + 2 * r := by
      have : ((2 * c * N + r : ℕ) : ℤ) < ((r * (jc c + 1) * 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hi
      push_cast at this; linarith
    rcases abs_cases ((jc c : ℤ) * r - (c : ℤ) * N) with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩ <;> rw [h] <;> linarith
  have jc_lt : ∀ c : ℕ, c < r → jc c < N := by
    intro c hc
    have h1 : (c + 1) * N ≤ r * N := Nat.mul_le_mul_right N hc
    show (2 * c * N + r) / (2 * r) < N
    rw [Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (by omega)]
    nlinarith
  -- every `jc c` is an outcome from which the period is recovered
  have hit : C.image jc ⊆ (range N).filter (fun j => recover N j = r) := by
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨c, hcC, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hj
    obtain ⟨hcr, hcop⟩ := mem_filter.mp hcC
    have hcop' : IsCoprime (c : ℤ) (r : ℤ) := Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.mpr hcop
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_range.mpr (jc_lt c (mem_range.mp hcr)),
      recover_period hr hrr hcop' (near c)⟩
  -- distinct `c` give distinct outcomes
  have hinj : Set.InjOn jc (C : Set ℕ) := by
    intro c _ c' _ heq
    have h1 := near c
    have h2 := near c'
    rw [heq] at h1
    have h3 : |((c : ℤ) - c') * N| ≤ r := by
      have : (c - c') * (N : ℤ) = (((jc c' : ℕ) : ℤ) * r - c' * N) - (((jc c' : ℕ) : ℤ) * r - c * N) := by
        ring
      rw [this]
      refine (abs_sub _ _).trans ?_
      rw [abs_sub_comm (((jc c' : ℕ) : ℤ) * r) (c * N)] at h1 ⊢
      linarith [abs_nonneg (((jc c' : ℕ) : ℤ) * r - c' * N)]
    have h4 : |(c : ℤ) - c'| < 1 := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      rw [abs_mul, Nat.abs_cast] at h3
      nlinarith
    have := abs_lt.mp h4
    omega
  have peak : ∀ c ∈ C, bound ≤ prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) (jc c) := by
    intro c hc
    have hcr := mem_range.mp (mem_filter.mp hc).1
    exact (shor_peak hr hrN hx0 (jc_lt c hcr) (near c)).2
  calc 4 / Real.pi ^ 2 * (((C.card : ℝ)) / r) * (1 - (r : ℝ) / N) ^ 3
      = ∑ _c ∈ C, bound := by
        rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, hbound]; field_simp
    _ ≤ ∑ c ∈ C, prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) (jc c) := sum_le_sum peak
    _ = ∑ j ∈ C.image jc, prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j := (sum_image hinj).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ (range N).filter (fun j => recover N j = r),
          prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j :=
        sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hit fun _ _ _ => by unfold prob; positivity

  fixes x :: real
  assumes "x \<ge> 0"
  shows "sin x \<le> x"
proof -
  let ?f = "\<lambda>x. x - sin x"

steps.message: No Jordan-type bound exists in the library, so I'll prove one. The file has two independent parts: the classical/combinatorial theorems and the analytic `shor_peak`. I'll hand the first part to a fork working in a separate directory so the two can be built and tested in parallel.

arguments.description: Prove shor_factor and shor_general_success
arguments.prompt:
You are the forked helper for PART B. I (the parent) am proving `shor_peak` in /app/Shor_General.thy myself — do NOT edit /app/Shor_General.thy and do NOT edit /app/Quantum_Basics.thy.

Your job: prove `shor_factor` and `shor_general_success` in Isar, in a separate scratch directory so builds don't clash:

1. `mkdir -p /tmp/partB` and copy `/app/Quantum_Basics.thy` there. Create `/tmp/partB/ROOT` with `session ShorB = HOL + theories ShorB` (plus Quantum_Basics as needed, same style as /app/ROOT, quick_and_dirty off).
2. Write `/tmp/partB/ShorB.thy` (theory ShorB, imports Quantum_Basics). Include a TEST-ONLY stub `lemma shor_peak:` with the exact statement from /app/Shor_General.thy, proved by `sorry` (the parent will supply the real proof; the stub is only so shor_general_success can use it). Then your proofs of `shor_factor` (exact statement from the .thy file) and `shor_general_success` (exact statement).
3. Build with `cd /tmp/partB && timeout 300 isabelle build -o threads=2 -D /tmp/partB` (use -D pointing at your dir). Iterate until clean (the only expected warning is the sorry in the stub).
4. Deliverable: write ONLY your helper lemmas + the two theorems (no theory header, no stub `shor_peak`, no `sorry`) to `/tmp/partB/part_b.thy`. It will be pasted into /app/Shor_General.thy, placed AFTER the shor_peak section and before the end of file, so helper names must not clash with names I might use (prefix your helpers with `sfb_`). Target at most ~200 lines. Only Isar `proof ... qed` blocks, `have/show/obtain`, and ordinary methods (simp, auto, metis, arith, blast, linarith-style via auto/simp, etc.). Forbidden: apply, done, sorry, oops, smt, sledgehammer, nitpick, quickcheck, axiomatization, oracle, ML, etc.

Math notes (you already have the reasoning in context):
- shor_factor: x = a^(r div 2); x^2 ≡ 1 mod n; x ≢ 1 (minimality of r, since 0 < r div 2 < r); x ≢ n-1 (hypothesis). gcd(x-1,n) ≠ 1 by coprimality argument (n | (x-1)(x+1), if coprime then n | x+1). gcd ≠ n since n | x-1 would give x ≡ 1. Use Isabelle's nat `gcd`, `coprime`, `Nat.coprime_dvd_mult_iff`-style lemmas (check names with `find_theorems` inside a scratch theory if needed, or just try `simp`/`metis`). Work with `mod` via `cong`/`mod_mult_left_eq`/`Divides` as convenient.
- shor_general_success: N > r*r, hence r < N. For c < r coprime to r, let jc c = (2*c*N + r) div (2*r) (nearest integer to cN/r); show 2*|jc c * r - c*N| ≤ r (integers), jc c < N, injective on the coprime set (distinct c give |c-c'|N ≤ r, forcing c=c' since r<N), and the recover lemma: for such j with the near condition, recover N j = r, using that for 0<b<r, the near condition for b with some a yields b*c = a*r (since |b c - a r| N ≤ r b < N), hence r | b (coprime), contradiction. Recover is `LEAST b. 0 < b ∧ (∃a::int. 2*|int j * int b - a * int N| ≤ int b)`; use `Least_equality`/`Least_le` style lemmas. Then per-c `shor_peak` gives each term ≥ bound = 4/(pi^2 r) (1-r/N)^3; sum over the coprime set (card = φ(r), definitionally the card in the statement), reindex by image under jc (sum_image with inj_on), and bound by sum over the superset {j<N. recover N j = r} using nonnegativity of prob (it's a square, `prob` unfolds to cmod^2). Note φ(r) in the statement is `card {c. c < r ∧ coprime c r}`: take care that the set is over naturals with `c < r`.
- Note the parent's shor_peak statement: `shor_peak` takes r>0, r<N, x0<r, j<N and `2 * |int j * int r - c * int N| ≤ int r` for some integer c (the c is existentially bound in the near hypothesis; in the theorem it's a variable `c` in `near`, so instantiate it per c).

Time: the whole team has ~60 minutes total from the start of the task; aim to have part_b.thy ready within ~30 minutes. When done, reply with a SHORT final message: path to part_b.thy, line count, whether the stub-based test build passed (exact result), and any statement you had to change (you must not change theorem statements). Keep the report under 150 words.

arguments.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/peak && cd /tmp/peak && cp /app/Quantum_Basics.thy . && cat > ROOT <<'EOF'
session PeakTest = HOL +
  options [quick_and_dirty = false]
  theories
    Quantum_Basics
    Peak_Test
EOF
cat > Peak_Test.thy <<'EOF'
theory Peak_Test
  imports Quantum_Basics
begin

lemma sfp_sin_cos_le: "0 \<le> u \<Longrightarrow> u \<le> pi / 2 \<Longrightarrow> u * cos u \<le> sin u"
proof -
  have "(\<lambda>x. sin x - x * cos x) 0 \<le> (\<lambda>x. sin x - x * cos x) u"
  proof (rule DERIV_nonneg_imp_nondecreasing)
    show "0 \<le> u" by fact
    fix x assume hx: "0 \<le> x \<and> x \<le> u"
    then have x0: "0 \<le> x" and x1: "x \<le> pi / 2" using assms by auto
    have d: "((\<lambda>x. sin x - x * cos x) has_real_derivative x * sin x) (at x)"
      by (auto intro!: derivative_eq_intros simp: field_simps)
    have "0 \<le> x * sin x" using x0 x1 sin_ge_zero[of x] by (intro mult_nonneg_nonneg) (linarith, linarith)
    with d show "\<exists>y. DERIV (\<lambda>x. sin x - x * cos x) x :> y \<and> 0 \<le> y" by blast
  qed
  then show ?thesis by simp
qed

lemma sfp_jordan_half: "0 < u \<Longrightarrow> u \<le> pi / 2 \<Longrightarrow> 2 / pi * u \<le> sin u"
proof -
  assume hu0: "0 < u" and hu1: "u \<le> pi / 2"
  have mono: "sin (pi / 2) / (pi / 2) \<le> sin u / u"
  proof (rule DERIV_nonpos_imp_nonincreasing[where f = "\<lambda>x. sin x / x"])
    show "u \<le> pi / 2" by fact
    fix x assume hx: "u \<le> x \<and> x \<le> pi / 2"
    then have xp: "0 < x" using hu0 by auto
    have d: "((\<lambda>x. sin x / x) has_real_derivative (x * cos x - sin x) / x ^ 2) (at x)"
      using xp by (auto intro!: derivative_eq_intros simp: power2_eq_square field_simps)
    have "(x * cos x - sin x) / x ^ 2 \<le> 0"
      using sfp_sin_cos_le[of x] hx xp by (intro divide_nonpos_nonneg) (auto)
    with d show "\<exists>y. DERIV (\<lambda>x. sin x / x) x :> y \<and> y \<le> 0" by blast
  qed
  have "2 / pi \<le> sin u / u" using mono by simp
  then have "2 / pi * u \<le> sin u / u * u" using hu0 by (intro mult_right_mono) auto
  also have "\<dots> = sin u" using hu0 by simp
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma sfp_jordan: "0 \<le> h \<Longrightarrow> h \<le> t \<Longrightarrow> t \<le> pi - h \<Longrightarrow> 2 / pi * h \<le> sin t"
proof (cases "t \<le> pi / 2")
  case True
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "h = 0")
    case True then show ?thesis using sin_ge_zero[of t] by simp
  next
    case False
    then have "0 < h" using \<open>0 \<le> h\<close> by simp
    have "2 / pi * h \<le> 2 / pi * t" using \<open>h \<le> t\<close> by simp
    also have "\<dots> \<le> sin t" using sfp_jordan_half[of t] \<open>0 < h\<close> \<open>h \<le> t\<close> True by simp
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
next
  case False
  then have "pi / 2 < t" by simp
  have "0 < pi - t" by (rule ccontr) (use \<open>t \<le> pi - h\<close> \<open>0 \<le> h\<close> in \<open>simp\<close>)
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "h = 0")
    case True then show ?thesis using sin_ge_zero[of t] by simp
  next
    case False
    then have "0 < h" using \<open>0 \<le> h\<close> by simp
    have "2 / pi * h \<le> 2 / pi * (pi - t)" using \<open>h \<le> pi - t\<close> by simp
    also have "\<dots> \<le> sin (pi - t)" using sfp_jordan_half[of "pi - t"] \<open>0 < pi - t\<close> \<open>h \<le> pi - t\<close> \<open>pi / 2 < t\<close> by simp
    also have "\<dots> = sin t" by simp
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
qed

lemma sfp_cis_sub_one_sq: "(cmod (cis x - 1)) ^ 2 = 4 * (sin (x / 2)) ^ 2"
proof -
  have hr: "Re (cis x - 1) = cos x - 1" by (simp add: cis_def)
  have hi: "Im (cis x - 1) = sin x" by (simp add: cis_def)
  have "cos x = 1 - 2 * (sin (x / 2)) ^ 2"
    using cos_double_sin[of "x / 2"] by simp
  then show ?thesis using cmod_power2[of "cis x - 1"] hr hi
    by (simp add: power2_eq_square field_simps) (smt (verit) sin_squared_eq)
qed

end
EOF

cd /tmp/peak && cat > Peak_Test.thy <<'EOF'
theory Peak_Test
  imports Quantum_Basics
begin

lemma sfp_sin_cos_le:
  assumes u0: "0 \<le> u" and u1: "u \<le> pi / 2"
  shows "u * cos u \<le> sin u"
proof -
  have "(\<lambda>x. sin x - x * cos x) 0 \<le> (\<lambda>x. sin x - x * cos x) u"
  proof (rule DERIV_nonneg_imp_nondecreasing)
    show "0 \<le> u" by fact
    fix x assume hx: "0 \<le> x \<and> x \<le> u"
    then have x0: "0 \<le> x" and x1: "x \<le> pi / 2" using u1 by auto
    have d: "((\<lambda>x. sin x - x * cos x) has_real_derivative x * sin x) (at x)"
      by (auto intro!: derivative_eq_intros simp: field_simps)
    have "0 \<le> x * sin x" using x0 x1 sin_ge_zero[of x] by (intro mult_nonneg_nonneg) (linarith, linarith)
    with d show "\<exists>y. DERIV (\<lambda>x. sin x - x * cos x) x :> y \<and> 0 \<le> y" by blast
  qed
  then show ?thesis by simp
qed

lemma sfp_jordan_half:
  assumes u0: "0 < u" and u1: "u \<le> pi / 2"
  shows "2 / pi * u \<le> sin u"
proof -
  have mono: "sin (pi / 2) / (pi / 2) \<le> sin u / u"
  proof (rule DERIV_nonpos_imp_nonincreasing[where f = "\<lambda>x. sin x / x"])
    show "u \<le> pi / 2" by fact
    fix x assume hx: "u \<le> x \<and> x \<le> pi / 2"
    then have xp: "0 < x" using u0 by auto
    have d: "((\<lambda>x. sin x / x) has_real_derivative (x * cos x - sin x) / x ^ 2) (at x)"
      using xp by (auto intro!: derivative_eq_intros simp: power2_eq_square field_simps)
    have "(x * cos x - sin x) / x ^ 2 \<le> 0"
      using sfp_sin_cos_le[of x] hx xp by (intro divide_nonpos_nonneg) (auto)
    with d show "\<exists>y. DERIV (\<lambda>x. sin x / x) x :> y \<and> y \<le> 0" by blast
  qed
  have "2 / pi \<le> sin u / u" using mono by simp
  then have "2 / pi * u \<le> sin u / u * u" using u0 by (intro mult_right_mono) auto
  also have "\<dots> = sin u" using u0 by simp
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma sfp_jordan:
  assumes h0: "0 \<le> h" and ht: "h \<le> t" and tp: "t \<le> pi - h"
  shows "2 / pi * h \<le> sin t"
proof (cases "t \<le> pi / 2")
  case True
  have "2 / pi * h \<le> 2 / pi * t" using ht by simp
  also have "\<dots> \<le> sin t" using sfp_jordan_half[of t] True ht h0 by (cases "h = 0") auto
  finally show ?thesis .
next
  case False
  have "2 / pi * h \<le> 2 / pi * (pi - t)" using tp by simp
  also have "\<dots> \<le> sin (pi - t)" using sfp_jordan_half[of "pi - t"] False tp h0 ht by (cases "h = 0") auto
  also have "\<dots> = sin t" by simp
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma sfp_cis_sub_one_sq: "(cmod (cis x - 1)) ^ 2 = 4 * (sin (x / 2)) ^ 2"
proof -
  have hr: "Re (cis x - 1) = cos x - 1" by (simp add: cis_def)
  have hi: "Im (cis x - 1) = sin x" by (simp add: cis_def)
  have "cos x = 1 - 2 * (sin (x / 2)) ^ 2"
    using cos_double_sin[of "x / 2"] by simp
  then show ?thesis using cmod_power2[of "cis x - 1"] hr hi
    by (simp add: power2_eq_square field_simps)
qed

end
EOF

    using DERIV_nonpos_imp_nonincreasing[of u "pi / 2" "\<lambda>x. sin x / x"] u1 key by simp
  have "2 / pi \<le> sin u / u" using mono by simp
  then have "2 / pi * u \<le> sin u / u * u" using up by (intro mult_right_mono) auto
  also have "\<dots> = sin u" using up by simp
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma sfp_jordan:
  assumes h0: "0 \<le> h" and ht: "h \<le> t" and tp: "t \<le> pi - h"
  shows "2 / pi * h \<le> sin t"
proof -
  have c: "0 \<le> 2 / pi" using pi_gt_zero by simp
  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "t \<le> pi / 2")
    case True
    have "2 / pi * h \<le> 2 / pi * t" using ht c by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
    also have "\<dots> \<le> sin t" using sfp_jordan_half[of t] True ht h0 by simp
    finally show ?thesis .
  next
    case False
    have "2 / pi * h \<le> 2 / pi * (pi - t)" using tp c by (intro mult_left_mono) auto
    also have "\<dots> \<le> sin (pi - t)" using sfp_jordan_half[of "pi - t"] False tp h0 ht pi_gt_zero by simp
    also have "\<dots> = sin t" by simp
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
qed

lemma sfp_cis_sub_one_sq: "(cmod (cis x - 1)) ^ 2 = 4 * (sin (x / 2)) ^ 2"
proof -
  have hr: "Re (cis x - 1) = cos x - 1" by (simp add: cis_def)
  have hi: "Im (cis x - 1) = sin x" by (simp add: cis_def)
  have "cos x = 1 - 2 * (sin (x / 2)) ^ 2"
    using cos_double_sin[of "x / 2"] by simp
  then show ?thesis using cmod_power2[of "cis x - 1"] hr hi
    by (simp add: power2_eq_square field_simps)
qed

subsection \<open>Part B: the classical step and period recovery\<close>

lemma sfb_mod_plus_one: "(m + 1) mod n = 1 \<Longrightarrow> n dvd m"
proof -
  assume h1: "(m + 1) mod n = 1"
  have h: "n * ((m + 1) div n) + (m + 1) mod n = m + 1" by (rule div_mult_mod_eq)
  have "m = n * ((m + 1) div n)" using h h1 by linarith
  then show "n dvd m" by (rule Dvd.dvdI)
qed

lemma sfb_abs_combo:
  fixes R Y X Z D NN :: int
  assumes hR: "0 \<le> R" and hY: "0 \<le> Y" and hN: "0 < NN"
    and eq: "NN * D = R * X - Y * Z"
    and hX: "2 * \<bar>X\<bar> \<le> Y" and hZ: "2 * \<bar>Z\<bar> \<le> R" and hRY: "R * Y < NN"
  shows "D = 0"
proof -
  have t1: "\<bar>R * X - Y * Z\<bar> \<le> \<bar>R * X\<bar> + \<bar>Y * Z\<bar>" by (rule abs_triangle_ineq4)
  have t2: "\<bar>R * X\<bar> + \<bar>Y * Z\<bar> = R * \<bar>X\<bar> + Y * \<bar>Z\<bar>" using hR hY by (simp add: abs_mult)
  have p1: "R * (2 * \<bar>X\<bar>) \<le> R * Y" by (rule mult_left_mono[OF hX hR])
  have p2: "Y * (2 * \<bar>Z\<bar>) \<le> Y * R" by (rule mult_left_mono[OF hZ hY])
  have t3: "NN * \<bar>D\<bar> \<le> R * Y"
  proof -
    have "NN * \<bar>D\<bar> = \<bar>NN * D\<bar>" using hN by (simp add: abs_mult)
    also have "\<dots> = \<bar>R * X - Y * Z\<bar>" using eq by simp
    also have "\<dots> \<le> R * \<bar>X\<bar> + Y * \<bar>Z\<bar>" using t1 t2 by simp
    also have "\<dots> \<le> R * Y" using p1 p2 by nlinarith
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  have t4: "\<bar>D\<bar> < 1"
  proof (rule ccontr)
    assume "\<not> \<bar>D\<bar> < 1"
    then have "1 \<le> \<bar>D\<bar>" by simp
    then show False using t3 hRY hN by nlinarith
  qed
  have t5: "D < 1 \<and> -1 < D" using t4 by (simp add: abs_less_iff)
  show ?thesis using t5 by omega
qed

lemma sfb_sep:
  fixes J C C' R NN :: int
  assumes hN: "0 < NN" and hRN: "R < NN"
    and h1: "2 * \<bar>J * R - C * NN\<bar> \<le> R" and h2: "2 * \<bar>J * R - C' * NN\<bar> \<le> R"
  shows "C = C'"
proof -
  have e: "NN * (C' - C) = (J * R - C * NN) - (J * R - C' * NN)" by (simp add: algebra_simps)
  have t1: "\<bar>NN * (C' - C)\<bar> \<le> R"
  proof -
    have "\<bar>NN * (C' - C)\<bar> = \<bar>(J * R - C * NN) - (J * R - C' * NN)\<bar>" using e by simp
    also have "\<dots> \<le> \<bar>J * R - C * NN\<bar> + \<bar>J * R - C' * NN\<bar>" by (rule abs_triangle_ineq4)
    finally show ?thesis using h1 h2 by linarith
  qed
  have t2: "NN * \<bar>C' - C\<bar> \<le> R" using t1 by (simp add: abs_mult abs_of_pos hN)
  have t3: "\<bar>C' - C\<bar> < 1"
  proof (rule ccontr)
    assume "\<not> \<bar>C' - C\<bar> < 1"
    then have "1 \<le> \<bar>C' - C\<bar>" by simp
    then show False using t2 hRN hN by nlinarith
  qed
  have t4: "C' - C < 1 \<and> -1 < C' - C" using t3 by (simp add: abs_less_iff)
  show ?thesis using t4 by omega
qed

lemma sfb_jc_near:
  assumes r0: "0 < r"
  shows "2 * \<bar>int ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
proof -
  have dm: "2 * r * ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) + (2 * c * N + r) mod (2 * r) = 2 * c * N + r"
    by (rule div_mult_mod_eq)
  have ml: "(2 * c * N + r) mod (2 * r) < 2 * r" using r0 by simp
  have gen: "\<And>q M :: nat. 2 * r * q + M = 2 * c * N + r \<Longrightarrow> M < 2 * r \<Longrightarrow>
      2 * \<bar>int q * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  proof -
    fix q M :: nat
    assume h1: "2 * r * q + M = 2 * c * N + r" and h2: "M < 2 * r"
    have z1: "2 * int r * int q + int M = 2 * int c * int N + int r" using h1 by (metis of_nat_add of_nat_mult of_nat_numeral)
    have z2: "int M < 2 * int r" using h2 by (metis of_nat_less_iff of_nat_mult of_nat_numeral)
    have z3: "0 \<le> int M" by simp
    rcases abs_cases (int q * int r - int c * int N) with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩ <;> rw [h] <;> nlinarith
  qed
  show ?thesis using gen[OF dm ml] .
qed

lemma sfb_jc_lt:
  assumes hc: "c < r" and hrN: "r < N"
  shows "(2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) < N"
proof -
  have hc1: "c + 1 \<le> r" using hc by simp
  have h1: "(c + 1) * N \<le> r * N" by (rule mult_le_mono1[OF hc1])
  have h2: "2 * c * N + r < N * (2 * r)" using h1 hrN by nlinarith
  have "r > 0" using hc by simp
  then show ?thesis using h2 by (simp add: Nat.div_less_iff_less_mul)
qed

lemma sfb_recover:
  assumes r0: "0 < r" and rr: "r * r < N" and cop: "coprime c r"
    and near: "2 * \<bar>int j * int r - int c * int N\<bar> \<le> int r"
  shows "recover N j = r"
proof -
  have least: "(LEAST b. 0 < b \<and> (\<exists>a::int. 2 * \<bar>int j * int b - a * int N\<bar> \<le> int b)) = r"
  proof (rule Least_equality)
    show "0 < r \<and> (\<exists>a::int. 2 * \<bar>int j * int r - a * int N\<bar> \<le> int r)"
      using r0 near by blast
  next
    fix y :: nat
    assume hy: "0 < y \<and> (\<exists>a::int. 2 * \<bar>int j * int y - a * int N\<bar> \<le> int y)"
    then obtain a :: int where y0: "0 < y" and ha: "2 * \<bar>int j * int y - a * int N\<bar> \<le> int y"
      by blast
    show "r \<le> y"
    proof (rule ccontr)
      assume "\<not> r \<le> y"
      then have yr: "y < r" by simp
      have y1: "y + 1 \<le> r" using yr by simp
      have yrN: "y * r < N"
      proof -
        have "(y + 1) * r \<le> r * r" by (rule mult_le_mono1[OF y1])
        then show ?thesis using rr by nlinarith
      qed
      have Npos: "0 < N" using rr by (cases N) auto
      have c1: "int r * int y < int N"
      proof -
        have "int (y * r) < int N" using yrN by simp
        then show ?thesis by (simp add: mult.commute)
      qed
      have D0: "int y * int c - a * int r = 0"
        by (rule sfb_abs_combo[of "int r" "int y" "int j * int y - a * int N"
              "int j * int r - int c * int N" "int y * int c - a * int r" "int N"])
           (use ha near c1 in \<open>simp_all add: algebra_simps\<close>)
      have dv: "int r dvd int (y * c)"
      proof -
        have "int (y * c) = int r * a" using D0 by (simp add: algebra_simps)
        then show ?thesis by simp
      qed
      have dvn: "r dvd y * c" using dv by (simp add: int_dvd_int_iff)
      have cop': "coprime r c" using cop by (simp add: coprime_commute)
      have "r dvd y" using dvn cop' by (rule Nat.Coprime.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right)
      then have "r \<le> y" using y0 by (rule Nat.le_of_dvd)
      then show False using yr by simp
    qed
  qed
  show ?thesis unfolding recover_def using least by simp
qed

theorem shor_factor:
  assumes n: "1 < n" and ord: "is_order n a r" and even: "even r"
    and not_minus_one: "a ^ (r div 2) mod n \<noteq> n - 1"
  shows "1 < gcd (a ^ (r div 2) - 1) n \<and> gcd (a ^ (r div 2) - 1) n < n"
proof -
  have ord': "0 < r \<and> a ^ r mod n = 1 \<and> (\<forall>k. 0 < k \<longrightarrow> k < r \<longrightarrow> a ^ k mod n \<noteq> 1)"
    using ord unfolding is_order_def by blast
  then have r0: "0 < r" and ar: "a ^ r mod n = 1"
    and minr: "\<forall>k. 0 < k \<longrightarrow> k < r \<longrightarrow> a ^ k mod n \<noteq> 1" by blast+
  have "2 dvd r" using even by (simp add: even_iff_2_dvd)
  then obtain s where rs: "r = 2 * s" unfolding dvd_def by blast
  have hs: "r div 2 = s" using rs by simp
  have s0: "0 < s" using r0 rs by simp
  have sr: "s < r" using rs s0 by simp
  have xx: "a ^ s * a ^ s = a ^ r" using rs by (simp add: mult_2 power_add)
  have xne: "a ^ s \<noteq> 0"
  proof
    assume h0: "a ^ s = 0"
    have "a ^ r = 0" using xx h0 by simp
    then show False using ar by simp
  qed
  obtain y where hy: "a ^ s = y + 1"
    using not0_implies_Suc[OF xne] by (metis Suc_eq_plus1)
  have e1: "(y + 1) * (y + 1) = a ^ r" using xx hy by simp
  have e2: "y * (y + 2) + 1 = a ^ r"
    by (rule sym) (simp add: e1[symmetric] algebra_simps)
  have m1: "(y * (y + 2) + 1) mod n = 1" using e2 ar by simp
  have dvd1: "n dvd y * (y + 2)" using sfb_mod_plus_one[OF m1] .
  have gy: "a ^ s - 1 = y" using hy by simp
  have hneg: "a ^ s mod n \<noteq> n - 1" using not_minus_one hs by simp
  have g0: "gcd y n \<noteq> 0" using n by auto
  have g1: "gcd y n \<noteq> 1"
  proof
    assume g: "gcd y n = 1"
    have cop: "coprime n y" using g by (simp add: gcd.commute Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_1)
    have dv2: "n dvd y + 2"
      using dvd1 cop by (metis Nat.Coprime.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left mult.commute)
    then obtain k where k: "y + 2 = n * k" unfolding dvd_def by blast
    have k1: "k \<noteq> 0" using k by auto
    obtain k' where kk: "k = k' + 1" using not0_implies_Suc[OF k1] by (metis Suc_eq_plus1)
    obtain m where nm: "n = m + 1" using n by (metis Suc_eq_plus1 less_imp_Suc_add)
    have ak: "a ^ s = (m + 1) * k' + m" using hy k kk nm by (simp add: algebra_simps) linarith
    have "a ^ s mod n = m"
      using ak nm by (simp add: mod_mult_self1)
    then show False using hneg nm by simp
  qed
  have g2: "gcd y n \<noteq> n"
  proof
    assume g: "gcd y n = n"
    have "n dvd y" using g Nat.gcd_dvd_left[of y n] by simp
    then obtain k where yk: "y = n * k" unfolding dvd_def by blast
    have "a ^ s mod n = 1"
      using hy yk n by (simp add: mod_mult_self1)
    then show False using minr s0 sr by blast
  qed
  have gle: "gcd y n \<le> n" using n Nat.gcd_dvd_right[of y n] by (intro Nat.le_of_dvd) auto
  have hs2: "a ^ (r div 2) = a ^ s" using hs by simp
  show ?thesis
    unfolding hs2 gy using g0 g1 g2 gle by omega
qed

theorem shor_general_success:
  assumes r: "0 < r" and rr: "r * r < N" and x0: "x0 < r"
  shows "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
    \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> {j. j < N \<and> recover N j = r}. prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j)"
proof -
  have rN: "r < N" using r rr by nlinarith
  have fin: "finite {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}" by (rule finite_subset[of _ "{..<r}"]) auto
  have finT: "finite {j. j < N \<and> recover N j = r}" by (rule finite_subset[of _ "{..<N}"]) auto
  have inj: "inj_on (\<lambda>c::nat. (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}"
  proof (rule inj_onI)
    fix c c' :: nat
    assume hc: "c \<in> {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}" and hc': "c' \<in> {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}"
      and heq: "(\<lambda>c::nat. (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) c = (\<lambda>c::nat. (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) c'"
    have heq': "(2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) = (2 * c' * N + r) div (2 * r)" using heq by simp
    have n1 := sfb_jc_near[where c=c and N=N and r=r, OF r]
    have n2 := sfb_jc_near[where c=c' and N=N and r=r, OF r]
    rw [heq'] at n1
    have "int c = int c'"
      by (rule sfb_sep[of "int N" "int r" "int ((2 * c' * N + r) div (2 * r))" "int c" "int c'"])
         (use rN n1 n2 in \<open>auto\<close>)
    then show "c = c'" by simp
  qed
  have recs: "\<And>c. c \<in> {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r} \<Longrightarrow> recover N ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) = r"
  proof -
    fix c assume hc: "c \<in> {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}"
    then have cop: "coprime c r" by simp
    show "recover N ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) = r"
      by (rule sfb_recover[OF r rr cop sfb_jc_near[OF r]])
  qed
  have subsT: "(\<lambda>c::nat. (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) ` {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}
      \<subseteq> {j. j < N \<and> recover N j = r}"
  proof
    fix j assume "j \<in> (\<lambda>c::nat. (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) ` {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}"
    then obtain c where hc: "c \<in> {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}" and hj: "(2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r) = j"
      by blast
    have "c < r" using hc by simp
    then have "j < N" using hj sfb_jc_lt[of c] rN by simp
    moreover have "recover N j = r" using hj recs hc by simp
    ultimately show "j \<in> {j. j < N \<and> recover N j = r}" by simp
  qed
  have peak: "\<And>c. c \<in> {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r} \<Longrightarrow>
      4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
        \<le> prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r))"
  proof -
    fix c assume hc: "c \<in> {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}"
    then have hcr: "c < r" by simp
    have pk := shor_peak[where N=N and r=r and x0=x0 and j="(2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)"
        and c="int c", OF r rN x0 sfb_jc_lt[OF hcr rN] sfb_jc_near[OF r]]
    show ?thesis using pk by blast
  qed
  have nonneg: "\<And>j. 0 \<le> prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j"
    unfolding prob_def by simp
  have hr0: "real r \<noteq> 0" using r by simp
  have hpi0: "pi \<noteq> 0" by simp
  have eqL: "4 / pi\<^sup>2 * (real (card {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}) / real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3
      = real (card {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}) * (4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)"
    using hr0 hpi0 by (simp add: field_simps)
  have s1: "(\<Sum>c \<in> {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}. 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)
      = real (card {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}) * (4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)"
    by (simp add: sum_constant)
  have s2: "(\<Sum>c \<in> {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}. 4 / (pi\<^sup>2 * real r) * (1 - real r / real N) ^ 3)
      \<le> (\<Sum>c \<in> {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}. prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)))"
    by (rule sum_mono) (use peak in blast)
  have s3: "(\<Sum>c \<in> {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}. prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) ((2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)))
      = (\<Sum>j \<in> (\<lambda>c::nat. (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) ` {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}.
          prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j)"
    by (rule sum_image[OF inj, symmetric])
  have s4: "(\<Sum>j \<in> (\<lambda>c::nat. (2 * c * N + r) div (2 * r)) ` {c. c < r \<and> coprime c r}.
          prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j)
      \<le> (\<Sum>j \<in> {j. j < N \<and> recover N j = r}. prob (qft N (periodic_state N r x0)) j)"
    by (rule sum_mono2[OF finT subsT]) (use nonneg in auto)
  show ?thesis using eqL s1 s2 s3 s4 by linarith
qed
